home.title: Book a viewing slot by date and 2-hour time blocks
home.summary: Each slot confirms up to 2 people. Extra bookings go to the waitlist. Classmates can jump the queue and get higher priority.
home.dateInvalid: Please choose a date from today through the next 50 days.
home.slotHint: A 4-hour simulator booking requires selecting two 2-hour slots.
home.name: Name
home.phonePlaceholder: Enter a mainland China mobile number
home.phoneHint: A mobile number can be left blank. It helps us contact waitlisted observers if they are promoted, especially when names may be duplicated.
home.phoneInvalid: Please enter a valid mainland China mobile number
home.priorityLevels: You can choose Normal or Classmate when booking.
home.priorityHint: Classmates can jump the queue, and same priority is sorted by submission time.
home.calendarHint: Before going to the simulator center, check the "Booking calendar" to confirm your booking was successful.
home.duplicateSlotSingle: Duplicate booking detected for the slot:
home.duplicateSlotMultiple: Duplicate bookings detected for the slots:
home.cancelRestoreHint: If you cannot make it because of a flight or other reason, remember to cancel it. After cancellation, it can still be restored with the original ranking.

barometric.title: Altitude and pressure converter
barometric.qrHint: Use your phone camera to scan the QR code.
barometric.expressionHint: Math expressions are supported. Use a dot for decimal values.
barometric.invalidHeight: Enter a valid height below 86 km.
barometric.invalidPressure: Enter a valid pressure within the model range.

airspeed.title: GS / TAS / Mach / CAS converter
airspeed.summary: Enter any one speed and calculate the others from altitude, temperature, and wind.
airspeed.temperatureHint: ISA standard temperature at this altitude: {temperature} °C

errors.invalid-input: Enter valid altitude, temperature, speed, and direction values.
errors.track-unachievable: The selected TAS and wind cannot maintain the requested track.

airspeed.chartTitle: Wind, true airspeed, and ground speed
airspeed.chartHint: True airspeed vector + wind vector = ground speed vector. Wind is entered from and drawn to.
airspeed.chartUnavailable: A valid wind triangle is not available for the current inputs.
airspeed.qrHint: Use your phone camera to scan the QR code.

rules.title: Booking rules
rules.slotRuleDesc: The day is split into 12 two-hour slots. Each slot confirms up to 2 people; extras join the waitlist.
rules.priorityRuleDesc: Classmates can jump the queue, and same priority is sorted by submission time.
rules.bookingRuleDesc: Enter a date, name, optional mobile number, and priority level on the home page, then select one or more slots.
rules.stepOneDesc: Pick the date you want, then select one or more time slots.
rules.stepTwoTitle: Fill in your name and submit
rules.stepTwoDesc: Enter your real name, optional mobile number, and priority level before submitting.
rules.stepThreeDesc: Teacher-specified comes first, then classmates, then normal bookings. Overflow bookings go to the waitlist.

calendar.title: View recent booked slots
calendar.cancelSuccessTitle: Cancellation successful. Please inform the waitlisted observers who have been confirmed.
calendar.cancelSuccessSubtitle: The following observers have moved from waitlist to confirmed:
calendar.canceledHint: If you cannot make it temporarily, you can cancel the booking first. It can still be restored later, and the original ordering will remain unchanged.

admin.title: Booking overview and export
admin.subcopy: Log in with an admin account to view and export data.
admin.bulkDeleteBody: This will delete the {count} selected bookings and cannot be undone.
admin.emptySearch: No bookings match the current search
admin.cleanupBody: This removes all bookings from yesterday and earlier and cannot be undone. It will not affect today or later.
